pages.title: Do Good and Share
pages.child_instruction: Color the children sharing extra bread and apples at a neighbor's porch.
pages.bible_connection: Sharing food is one way to do good, which Hebrews 13:16 says pleases God.
pages.visual_prompt: Integrated black line-art coloring scene: two children on a neighbor porch handing over a basket of apples and a loaf, an older neighbor at the door, extra jars on the step. Not the Mission 1 church festival. No letters in the artwork.

pages.title: Find What We Can Share
pages.child_instruction: Find and circle all 8 things we can share. Sharing is a way to do good.
pages.bible_connection: Each item is a picture of doing good and sharing, which God is pleased with.
pages.visual_prompt: Controlled porch-and-yard background without the eight targets. Independently placed extra apple, loaf, soup pot, empty bowl, pair of gloves, jar of jam, note card, and wagon.

pages.title: Take the Extra Basket
pages.child_instruction: Start at the extra basket. Follow the path to the neighbor's door.
pages.bible_connection: Taking the extra basket to a neighbor is a picture of doing good and sharing.
pages.visual_prompt: One village-lane scene: extra harvest basket at START, unique fence-and-path maze, neighbor door with a welcome mat at FINISH. Not a maze pasted on a blank page.

pages.title: How Can You Share This Week?
pages.child_instruction: Check how you can share. Then draw one thing you can give.
pages.bible_connection: These choices are child-sized ways to do good and share, as Hebrews 13:16 teaches.
pages.visual_prompt: One basket-framed page: four illustrated choices, a large open-basket drawing area, and a short prayer ribbon.
pages.drawing_prompt: Draw one thing you can share this week
pages.prayer: God, help me remember to do good and to share.
